proposals.title: Proposal 6 — Equal Voting Rights for Each Share
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Board to ensure all outstanding stock has equal one-vote-per-share, including encouraging dual-class holders to relinquish preexisting voting rights.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST Proposal 6 because it is not in the best interests of Ford or its shareholders.

proposals.title: Proposal 7 – Child Labor Audit
proposals.proponent: The National Center for Public Policy Research
proposals.topic_summary: Asks Ford to report from 2024 on the extent to which EV and charging-station business plans may rely on child labor outside the United States.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST Proposal 7 because it is not in the best interests of Ford and its shareholders.

proposals.title: Proposal 8 – Transparency and Minimization of Animal Testing
proposals.proponent: People for the Ethical Treatment of Animals (PETA), on behalf of Nancy Rinzler
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Company to issue an annual report disclosing the number and species of animals used or euthanized in company-funded testing not required by law.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST Proposal 8 because it is not in the best interests of Ford or its shareholders.
